answer: Challenge-bonded invitations: an invitee gets a seat only after a sponsor locks 50 POA for 10 epochs, and sponsors may hold at most 3 live invitees. A sponsor's lock per extra invitee grows by 40%, so a garden of ten fakes needs thousands of POA. Auditors replay the prism of invite records on-chain, and a reef of colluding sponsors loses 80% of every lock when two audits agree.
